<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Create a revocable reservation against usable inventory"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/reservations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Binds a quantity of a SKU's usable inventory (on-hand minus existing reservations, first-fit across whichever StockUnits have usable quantity) to a piece of demand identified by demandRef. The reservation is NOT permanently bound to one physical StockUnit — the specific units/quantities drawn from are recorded as Allocations, but a subsequent revoke-and-reserve cycle is free to draw from a different holding. This is what lets a failed physical pick be retried without stranding the order. The reservation expires automatically after a timeout if never confirmed or revoked. Idempotent (best-effort) by (demandRef, sku, quantity): retrying this call after a dropped response returns the existing ACTIVE reservation for the same demandRef, SKU and quantity instead of creating a second one (see REST_AUDIT.md's idempotency notes). One demandRef (e.g. an order) may hold several ACTIVE reservations at once -- one per line/SKU -- so a request for a different SKU or quantity under the same demandRef is always a new reservation.
